messages:
Carmen L: Morning — quick sprint update. Kernel backlog: three items left for continuous batching perf fix. Owners: Ben for batching logic, Alice for kernel changes, Diego for KV warmup. I pushed a short repro in PR 1123. Timeline: fast follow by EOD Thu. Any blockers?
Ben H: Reviewing the repro now. I see an N^2 loop in the microbatcher. Tentative fix in draft PR #1167. Will try to land tomorrow morning.
Alice M: Heads-up: kernel change needs a microbenchmark before landing. I can add one but need test vector from Ben. @Ben H can you paste example input? :mag:
Ben H: example below:
```
seq_len=512
batch=8
payload=random
```
sent perf baseline: p50=22ms p95=80ms, after local patch: p50=18ms p95=62ms
Diego R: KV warmup still flaky on GPU-D nodes — saw cold starts at ~1.2s for first token. Opened issue #348. Working on lowering prefetch concurrency. Need help validating across instance types.
Carmen L: Can infra help run a small matrix? @infra-bot queue perf-matrix job: tags=GPU-D,GPU-E zones=us-west1,europe-west1 -- owners Ben,Diego
infra-bot: Job queued: perf-matrix/1816008001. Estimate ~45m. Link: https://builds.internal/perf-matrix/1816008001 :gear:
Ben H: I'll follow the job and capture logs. If the microbench looks good we can canary to staging.
Alice M: Also pinging @eng-sre for priority on GPU-D warmup bug. We need stable cold-start numbers to hit SLO.
Diego R: FYI I repro'd coldstart with `./tools/coldstart_test --node GPU-D --runs 20` — attached snippet of logs in the PR.
Carmen L: Next milestone: merge kernel patch + KV warmup tweak + perf-matrix green. Target: Fri EOD for canary. If anything slips, call it out in-thread.
Ben H: PR #1167 -> updated, requesting review: https://git.redwood/1167 :thumbsup:
Alice M: I'll add the microbenchmark and smoke test. ETA tonight.
eng-sre-bot: Noted. I'll prioritize GPU-D node queue for warmup tests.
Diego R: Thanks — will update issue #348 with job link and raw logs.
Carmen L: Thanks team. Quick ask — if you can't make ETA, drop a 1-line update here by noon PST. Cheers.
